Placeholders: {player} {npc} {occupation} {town} {mood} {fame} {level} {hour} {master} {rival} {rumor} {where:<place kind>}. No next: the conversation ends.

text: Hm? Oh, hello.
Yes? Can I help you?
Nice day, isn't it?
Hello there, traveler.
I don't think we've met. I'm {npc}.
A new face! Welcome to {town}. I'm {npc}.
Oh! You're not from around here, are you? Name's {npc}.
Oh... um, hello. I'm {npc}. Sorry, I don't talk to strangers much.
H-hi. {npc}. That's me.
Welcome, welcome! {npc}, merchant of {town}. Best prices this side of the mountains.
A customer! I'm {npc}. If you need anything, I probably sell it.
Hmm. Your ki is... interesting. I am {npc}, I teach at the dojo here.
You carry yourself like a fighter. I am {npc}, master of the {town} dojo.
Hold on. Haven't seen you before. I'm {npc}, I keep the peace in {town}. Behave and we'll get along.
Name's {npc}, town guard. Visitors are welcome. Trouble isn't.
Whoa, are you a fighter too? I'm {npc}! I train at the dojo under {master}!
Hey! I'm {npc}. I'm going to be the strongest in {town} one day!
Hungry? You look hungry. I'm {npc}, I run the kitchen at the restaurant.
Welcome! I'm {npc}. Fighters eat a lot, I know. Come by the restaurant.
Oh! A visitor. I'm {npc}. Mind the cables, I'm in the middle of something.
Hello there. {npc}, research division. Don't touch anything that blinks.
Mind the rows! Oh, a visitor. I'm {npc}, I grow most of what {town} eats.
Hello! {npc}. If you're hungry, the radishes are nearly ready.
Good to see you, {player}! What a day!
Ah, {player}! I'm in a fine mood today.
*yawn* Oh, it's you, {player}. It's late...
Mm? Sorry, I'm half asleep.
What is it?
Make it quick, {player}.
Not now. I'm in no mood.
What do YOU want?
Did you see that? I don't feel safe today.
Oh, {player}... Everyone's on edge.
{player}! I can't believe it's really you!
Oh wow, oh wow, it's {player}!
{player}! Always good to see a friend.
There you are, {player}. I was hoping you'd come by.
You. What do you want?
I haven't forgotten, {player}.
People talk about you, you know, {player}.
Everyone in {town} knows your name now, {player}.
The {player}? Here, in {town}? Wait till I tell everyone!
I've heard so much about you, {player}. Is it all true?
Not now! Can't you see we're under attack?
Get inside! It's not safe!
Stay sharp, {player}. They could come back any moment.
If you can fight, help us hold them off!
You've got some nerve showing your face here after what you did.
Stay away from me! Guards!
Wha-? It's the middle of the night! Go to bed, {player}.
Zzz... huh? Come back in the morning.
Browsing or buying? Browsing costs nothing. Today.
Everything's for sale, {player}. For the right price.
I'm {npc}. I've lived in {town} a while now.
Just {npc}. Nothing special about me.
I am {npc}. I have walked the path of martial arts longer than you have been alive, I'd wager.
{npc}. I teach. Once I fought; now I watch others learn what I learned the hard way.
{npc}. I watch the roads and keep the peace. Somebody has to.
I'm {npc}, the guard. If anything dangerous comes to {town}, it goes through me first.
I'm {npc}! I'm a student at the dojo. {master} says I've got potential!
{npc}, student of {master}. I train every day so I can be as strong as the fighters you hear about!
{npc}, purveyor of fine goods. My family has kept shop in {town} for three generations.
A merchant. Capsules, tools, rice, you name it.
{npc}. I cook. Big portions. Fighters eat like ten people, you know.
I run the kitchen. Ever tried my fried dumplings? No? We'll fix that.
{npc}. I'm a scientist. Capsules, engines, a little of everything.
I do research. Mostly I take things apart to see why they work, then make them smaller.
{npc}. I farm. Up before the sun, down after it.
A farmer. Rice, radishes, cabbages, whatever the season gives.
I'm {npc}. And you? Where are you from? What's it like out there?
{npc}. I've always wanted to see the world beyond {town}.
Me? Oh, I'm... nobody really. Just {npc}.
I-I'm {npc}. I keep to myself, mostly.
Oh, a bit of this and that. Mostly I enjoy the quiet life in {town}.
I help out where I can. It's a small town; everyone does a bit of everything.
I keep the shop, {where:shop} from here. Buy low, sell high, smile a lot.
Trade! Goods come in from the city, I sell them on. Business has been good lately.
I run the kitchen at the restaurant, {where:tavern} from here. Come at noon or evening.
Cooking! Breakfast at dawn, lunch at noon, dinner after sunset. The fighters from the dojo eat most of it.
I work in the lab, {where:lab} from here. Long hours, but the coffee is free.
Research! We're trying to fit a whole house into a capsule. A bigger house, I mean. We already did the small one.
My fields are {where:field} from here. Come and lend a hand at harvest.
Weeding, watering, chasing off crows. Same as every day, and I wouldn't change it.
I walk the rounds: the roads, the gates, the plaza. Day and night, in shifts.
Keeping {town} safe. Bandits, wild animals, the odd hothead who thinks he's the strongest in the world.
I train at the dojo! Mornings and afternoons. {master} is tough, but fair.
Training, training, training! I'm going to master the Ki Blast, then something even bigger.
I teach the young ones at the dojo. Discipline first, then technique, then power.
I run the dojo. Strength without control is just noise.

options.text: I'll let you get back to it.

text: Well, I did hear something... {rumor}
Funny you should ask. {rumor}
You didn't hear? {rumor}
Nothing new, I'm afraid. Quiet days in {town}.
Hmm, no. Nothing I haven't told you already.
Not a thing. Maybe ask around.
Nothing yet. But merchants hear everything sooner or later. Come back tomorrow.
Between you and me... {rumor}
Keep this quiet. {rumor}
Oh, oh! Did you hear? {rumor}
{town}? It's a quiet place. A plaza with a fountain, a shop, a restaurant and a dojo. Everybody knows everybody.
Small, but it's home. The dojo draws fighters from all over, you know.
Two roads, two gates, one fountain. Easy to watch, hard to sneak into. Just how I like it.
Peaceful people. Too peaceful, perhaps; they forget the world outside has monsters in it.
Normally it's peaceful! Today... today I'm not so sure.
That would be {master}. Strict, but the students adore them.
{master}. They say they once fought in the World Martial Arts Tournament.
I do. My door is open to anyone willing to sweat.

say: The dojo is {where:dojo}. Follow the sound of shouting.
The shop is {where:shop}. The market stalls are {where:market}.
The restaurant is {where:tavern}. Tell them {npc} sent you.
The nearest gate is {where:gate}. Safe travels.

text: Oh, nothing much. Just enjoying the day.
Hmm... I was thinking about dinner, honestly.
I want to be the strongest in {town}. No, the world! You'll see.
Every day I get a little stronger. One day nobody will be able to beat me.
I want {master} to notice me. I train harder than anyone, but they never say a word.
If I could just land one clean hit on {master} in practice...
I am looking for a student worthy of everything I know. They are rare.
Teaching is easy. Finding someone worth teaching is hard.
Business, business. A good month means a good year.
If more travelers came through, I could finally expand.
There's a problem I can't let go of. The numbers almost work. Almost.
If I could just get the prototype stable, it would change everything. Well, a few things.
If the weather holds, this'll be the best harvest in years.
A good harvest, that's all I want. Fighters can keep their tournaments.
Money, {player}. Money is on my mind. It always is.
I keep thinking about what's past the mountains. One day I'll go and see.
Have you been far? I'd love to travel someday.
Keeping these people safe. That's all I think about.
Something's coming. I can feel it. I want {town} to be ready.
Peace and quiet. That's all I want out of life.
A nap in the sun by the fountain. Perfect.
Honestly? I'm scared. With all these fighters around, how long until one comes here?
A spar? Sure, I could use the practice. Go easy... or don't!
You're on! Just a spar, mind.
You want to spar with me? Ha! All right, I'll go easy on you.
Bold. Very well, let's see what you've got.
Me? Against you? Well... I'll learn something, at least.
All right! Don't hold back too much, I want to learn.
Oh... um, okay. If you want to.
Not today, I'm not up to it.
Maybe another time.
Sorry doesn't heal bruises. But... I'll remember you said it.
Hmph. Words are cheap. Show me with deeds.
Well... everyone makes mistakes. Just don't do it again.
I don't forgive that easily.
Hey, isn't that {player}?
Look, it's {player}! The one everyone talks about!
{player}! Welcome to {town}!
{player}! Will you watch me train? Please?
Wow, the real {player}! I'm a huge fan!
{player}! A hero like you needs supplies, surely?
So you're {player}. You don't look so tough to me.
{player}, huh? One day I'll beat you.
Hey, {player}!
Good to see you again, {player}.
{player}! Over here!
You! Stay back!
It's the one who attacked us!
Guards! Guards!
You've got some nerve coming back here.
Leave {town}. Now.
Lovely weather today.
Did you try the new dumplings at the restaurant?
The fountain's running again, I see.
My back's been killing me all week.
Have you seen the students training? So much energy.
Quiet shift. I like quiet shifts.
Keep your eyes open on the east road tonight.
{master} made us do a thousand push-ups today!
I almost had my ki blast stable this morning!
Prices are up again. Don't ask me why.
Business is slow. Tell your friends about my shop!
The prototype exploded again. Small explosion. Mostly.
Someone keeps borrowing my tools and returning them upside down.
Something's been digging up the carrots again.
Rain's coming. I can feel it in my knees.
I don't like how many fighters are around lately.
I heard there was trouble on the roads.
